outlets.name: Guide MICHELIN Deutschland
outlets.credible: The Michelin Guide (German edition), the definitive institutional dining authority; a lone Michelin listing/star clears the source bar. Used for Bagatelle (Trier), Belle Epoque (Traben-Trarbach) and Rüssels Landhaus (Naurath/Wald).

outlets.name: VDP – Verband Deutscher Prädikatsweingüter
outlets.credible: Germany's association of top Prädikat wine estates and its vineyard classification (German/English); an institutional wine authority. Used for Van Volxem (Wiltingen) and Grans-Fassian (Leiwen).

outlets.name: Der Feinschmecker
outlets.credible: Leading German gourmet magazine and restaurant/café guide; a credible editorial listing. Used for Belle Epoque and Café Konditorei Raab.

outlets.name: Wochenspiegel (wochenspiegellive.de)
outlets.credible: Regional German newspaper/portal for the Trier area; local press coverage (reported Bagatelle defending Trier's only Michelin star).

outlets.name: GUSTO – Der kulinarische Reiseführer
outlets.credible: Established German fine-dining rating guide; a credible corroborator for gourmet restaurants (Rüssels Landhaus).

outlets.name: Restaurant-Ranglisten.de
outlets.credible: German restaurant-guide aggregator collating Michelin/Gault&Millau/Feinschmecker/Gusto ratings; a credible measure of standing. Used for Rôtisserie Royale.

outlets.name: Weinland Mosel (Moselwein e.V.)
outlets.credible: Official marketing body of the Mosel wine-growing region (Moselwein e.V.), German; authoritative registry of Mosel estates. Used for Weingut Schleimer (Trier-Olewig).

outlets.name: Top Magazin Trier
outlets.credible: Regional Trier lifestyle/city magazine with editorial wine-and-dine coverage; credible local press (Hotel Weingut Weis / Restaurant Vinum).

outlets.name: Bernkastel-Kues Tourist-Information (bernkastel.de)
outlets.credible: Official DMO/tourist information of Bernkastel-Kues (German/English); authoritative local gastronomy source. Used for Ratskeller Bernkastel.

outlets.name: Frommer's
outlets.credible: Established US-authored travel guide covering the Mosel; names the Lohspeicher/L'Auberge du Vin as the best table in Cochem (candidate held pending a second source).
